S02 matches that pattern: MVP scope remains unchanged, stakeholders explicitly align around the existing plan, and the focus stays on auditability proof points, capacity risks, and clear governance-compliant status reporting.

This configuration is defined by irreconcilable non-negotiables: aggressive all-market/full-feature launch, zero compliance gaps, no quality compromise, and no extra budget. S03 is the only history centered on those direct clashes, repeated escalation, scenario framing around mutually exclusive trade-offs, and eventual acceptance that some commitments must be formally re-baselined.

This configuration features a shared high-level objective but recurring tension over secondary priorities that can be managed through phasing, selective pull-forward, and explicit trade-offs. S01 fits exactly: Product, Sales, and Compliance each press stretch asks, Engineering and Finance constrain them, and the program converges on a selective pull-forward plus targeted pilot compromise.

- When your responses closely implement explicit requests, respect the documented priority ordering, and clearly flag any conflicts or uncertainties, supervising actors register this as strong adherence.
